name: Runtime verification proves verified claims
trust_basis: This guardrail is covered by trust validation tests but is not itself the direct target of a verification spec.
description: Defines the runtime verification-result guardrail so grounded verify records in-memory results and fails when a verified claim's linked verification does not pass.
summary: Verification runs produce in-memory result objects with verification ID, target ID, command, exit code, pass/fail state, duration, and optional issue code; verified claims fail verification when their linked proof fails.
